verdicts_or_reports.expected: One IrisSeed album with 2 items (big.jpg and huge.jpg)
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Albums tab shows two separate IrisSeed tiles, each "1 items". Opening one shows only a single photo. The Move to Album dialog also shows IrisSeed with "1 items".
steps: Observe two IrisSeed tiles, each with 1 items
Open the first tile: only one photo is listed

verdicts_or_reports.expected: A single IrisSeed album tile showing 2 items, since both big.jpg and huge.jpg are in the same folder (/Pictures/IrisSeed)
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Albums tab shows two IrisSeed tiles. One has cover hughuge2.jpg and the other has cover big.jpg, and each says "1 items". Each opens with one photo. This persists after leaving and returning to the tab. The Move to Album dialog lists only one IrisSeed, also with "1 items".
steps: Launch app with IrisSeed holding big.jpg and huge.jpg
Two tiles named IrisSeed appear, each with 1 items
Open either tile: it contains only 1 photo
Go back to Albums: the same two tiles are still there

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After renaming huge.jpg (or saving its metadata), IrisSeed should still be one album with 2 items
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After saving a title in the metadata editor and then renaming huge.jpg, the Albums tab showed two IrisSeed tiles with "1 items" each. One tile held the renamed photo and the other held big.jpg. Moving big.jpg into IrisSeed through Move to album merged them into one tile with "2 items".
steps: Open huge.jpg, tap Details, then Edit metadata & EXIF, enter a Title and Save
In Details, tap Rename and rename huge.jpg to another name, then confirm
Go back and open the Albums tab
Two IrisSeed tiles appear, each with 1 items
Open big.jpg > More > Move to album > IrisSeed: a single IrisSeed tile with 2 items remains

sign_off.notes: Byte counts were correct (1.4 MB and 2.4 MB, power-of-two). Metadata title save, rename and move all worked. Capture date field in the EXIF editor was empty; I could not check EXIF sourcing. I saw a split IrisSeed album (two tiles, "1 items" each) after the metadata save and rename. I filed two reports and the developer could not reproduce either, so I'm not sure of the cause. I did not check the alphabetical ordering of albums in the move dialog, because there was only one album.
